verdict.rationale: The machine-readable pricing page, verified live by probe, states that 2FAS Auth ships with "no telemetry". That removes the need for an opt-out because there is no tracking to disable, and 2FAS Pass adds "100% anonymous use" with no registration. missing for 10: no explicit no-telemetry or tracking statement for 2FAS Pass or the browser extensions, no detailed privacy-policy documentation of data collection, and no independent or hands-on network verification of the no-telemetry claim.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking

citations.quote: Price: $0 — no tiers, no premium, no in-app purchases, no advertising, no telemetry.
100% anonymous use. Download the app and start using it without any registration.
